analysis.title: Hormuz, Hacks, & Huang-less NVDA: Tanker Pops & Network Drops Spark Safe-Haven Shift Across Markets
key_insights: Broad de-risking on Nov 17 with stocks and crypto lower and bonds and gold bid. The largest cross-asset move followed a ~10:30 ET CNN headline that the US national security communications network had gone down. Jay Clayton later said the US was not under a nation-state cyber-attack, which lifted NDX off its lows.

WSJ reported the SEC is probing Nvidia, including whether disclosures misled investors, amid CEO Jensen Huang's departure. The headline hit just before the close, ahead of NVDA earnings on the evening of Nov 18.
SPX closed below its 200-day moving average for the first time since April. The Dow broke down to its 200DMA, held briefly, then broke lower. The Dow was the worst major index on the day.

The selloff was not AI or tech-led. AI and SPX ex-AI fell together, and Mag7 and the SPX 493 both fell about 1%. Among AI leaders NeoClouds were hit least and software infrastructure the most. All equity sectors closed lower, led by tech.
'Most shorted' stocks were sold from the open for the fourth day in a row, although Nov 17 opened with a squeeze first. Semis retested early-November lows and VIX rose above 27.
Credit weakened with equities. IG and hyperscaler spreads widened, data-center credit was weaker, and spreads were wider in every IG and HY sector.

WTI reached $85 intraday and rebounded on renewed Middle East shipping incidents, then sold off late to end roughly unchanged. Al Jazeera reported five vessels struck in and around the Strait of Hormuz, and the US reportedly struck locations on Iran's Qeshm Island.

Bearish oil drivers overnight were improving Gulf export flows and VP Vance saying the US would not stay in the Iran conflict forever. Bullish drivers were tanker fire images and fewer empty tankers heading to collect Middle East crude, per Tankertrackers.com. The prompt oil spread is back at zero.
US natural gas jumped and decoupled from Europe on colder forecasts and lower production, with Bakken output down an estimated 2.4% day-on-day. Diesel was flat near 3-month lows.

Treasury yields fell about 3-4bps across the curve, with the 10Y near 5.10%. Strong retail sales, weak industrial production (weather), weak home sales sentiment and the CNN headline outweighed hawkish Fed speakers and higher oil.

St. Louis Fed's Musalem backed 'several' rate hikes before spring 2027, and the dollar briefly hit a fresh 19-month high. NY Fed's Williams said inflation work remains but dramatic action is not called for. Cleveland Fed's Hammack said the Fed should set a high bar for Treasury market interventions and supported expanding standing repo facility hours.
Jan 2027 rate-hike odds fell on the day as equity weakness outweighed the hawkish Fed commentary. The report cites Goldman's earlier note on reflexivity between stocks and rate-hike odds.

The dollar fell after a 5-day rally and a double-top, dropping sharply on the CNN headline. The yen outperformed. Gold gained only marginally at first and gave it back as oil slipped late. Bitcoin sold off like high-beta tech on the NSA report.

NVDA options price about an 8% move either way for earnings, the largest expected earnings reaction since Feb 2025. 1-month implied vol is the highest heading into a print since March 2025, and 3-month vol is above 50% from the low 30s in early October. In 8 of the last 10 reports the realized move was below the implied move, the exception being Aug 2026.
UBS notes SPX options price Wednesday as the largest one-day move for the rest of the year. Gamma is near record, which forces dealers to sell into dips and buy into rallies.

market_movers.rationale: SEC probe reported by WSJ amid CEO Huang's departure, ahead of earnings on Nov 18. Options price an 8% move.

earnings_insights: NVDA reports after the close on Nov 18 (the report's 'tonight'). The options-implied earnings move is about 8% either way, the largest since Feb 2025. This is an options-market expectation, not a result.
NVDA realized absolute earnings moves were below the implied move in 8 of the last 10 completed reports, with the Aug 2026 report the clear exception.
